Classes are offered for all levels and ages to assure participants progress at their own pace. Basic gymnastics skills on all apparatus provide a strong base of functional movements that enhances strength, flexibility and coordination. Technique and form are also emphasized because we know you want to look good doing the skills too! services.name: Birthday Parties
services.desc: The Gymnastics Party party will commence with a warm up game and stretch. Following the warm up game, a multitude of various activities led by an instructor will entertain the children on beam, trampoline, tumble track, Parkour area, bars, and various other creative circuits for 10-15 minutes on each of the events. The total gym portion time of the party is 60 minutes. After the 1 hour spent in the gym, the participants will be able to join celebrate in the party room for 45 minutes with cake (not included) and pizza (optional) and Juice (optional).
